phase_ledger.name: Slate, schedule, venue
phase_ledger.detail: Schedule, kickoff, site, roof, surface, rest days, listed QBs.

phase_ledger.name: Player identity and position
phase_ledger.detail: Positions from weekly rosters (GSIS IDs). Name-only joins are used for snap counts and PFR defenders.

phase_ledger.name: Verified player game history
phase_ledger.detail: Per-game logs for QBs, receivers and rushers over the window, from play-by-play.

phase_ledger.name: Role, snaps, routes, opportunity
phase_ledger.detail: Target share, air-yards share, carry share, red-zone looks, snap share. Routes run and route participation are NOT available.

phase_ledger.name: Team offense/defense baselines
phase_ledger.detail: Allowed and produced tables with league ranks and game-by-game trends.

phase_ledger.name: Opponent context and game script
phase_ledger.detail: Market spread/total, neutral pass rate, pace. The script call itself is the analyst's.

phase_ledger.name: Coverage structure and shell
phase_ledger.detail: Blitz and play-action rates from FTN charting. Man/zone and shell are NOT in any free source here.

phase_ledger.name: Defender assignment and explosive allowance
phase_ledger.detail: Per-defender targets/yards allowed (PFR) and explosive plays allowed. Who covers whom is NOT known.

phase_ledger.name: QB pressure, blitz, scramble
phase_ledger.detail: Sack rate, sacks + QB hits rate (a floor on pressure), blitz rate, scrambles.

phase_ledger.name: Offensive line, pass rush, coaching
phase_ledger.detail: Depth-chart line, pressure allowed, run yards by direction, pass-rush leaders. No line grades.

phase_ledger.name: Injury and depth chart
phase_ledger.detail: Official weekly report and depth chart; ESPN live list when reachable. Recent roster arrivals/departures.

phase_ledger.name: Weather, roof, travel
phase_ledger.detail: Roof, surface, rest days, site; National Weather Service kickoff forecast: INDOOR.

phase_ledger.name: Timestamped book prices
phase_ledger.detail: Pinnacle / DraftKings / FanDuel prices with no-vig and first-seen-to-now movement, no player props in this run. No FTN model, no true opening line.

phase_ledger.name: Projection and simulation
phase_ledger.detail: Period-engine team scores; player baselines. Not the three-model consensus; not validated.

phase_ledger.name: Final inactive pregame freeze
phase_ledger.detail: Inactives post about 90 minutes before kickoff. Re-run or check them by hand before any final call.
